components.name: Tournament primary action
components.description: Lime action used for creation, submission and publication; disabled controls retain their native disabled state.

components.name: Tournament neutral action
components.description: Secondary operations use a white surface and thin border.

components.name: Tournament field
components.description: Visible Vietnamese labels sit above white fields; code fields use JetBrains Mono.
components.html: <label class="ds-tc-field">Tên giải<input placeholder="Giải lập trình bot khoa CNTT" /></label>
components.css: .ds-tc-field{display:grid;gap:7px;font:550 13px/1.65 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;color:#20291f;margin:15px 0}.ds-tc-field input{font:400 14px/1.65 'Be Vietnam Pro',sans-serif;border:1px solid #bec4b6;background:#fff;border-radius:7px;padding:10px 12px;color:#20291f;min-width:0;caret-color:#4e712a}.ds-tc-field input::placeholder{color:#68735e;opacity:1}.ds-tc-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #749b37;outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Tournament navigation
components.description: Midnight rail with lime selection; the mobile arrangement exposes two columns including the BTC entry for administrators.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tc-nav" aria-label="Giải đấu"><button class="ds-tc-active">Giải đấu</button><button>Bài nộp của đội</button><button>Lịch đấu & replay</button><button>Ban tổ chức</button></nav>

components.name: Tournament status
components.description: Noninteractive lifecycle label; meaning is expressed in Vietnamese text rather than color alone.

components.name: Tournament event row
components.description: A whole-row button opens a tournament; detailed standings and operational data use flat tables.

narrative.overview: The user delegated the visual direction. A warm ivory application shell, narrow midnight navigation rail, and ink-blue arena establish a calm workspace for long coding sessions. Citrus green marks actions and active play; coral identifies the opposing side. Solid fills, crisp edges, no gradients. Typography uses Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese content and JetBrains Mono for code and coordinates.
